decisionSource: Direct teacher interview defining the original Academy form fields.

fields.meaning: The complete requested evaluation title; do not split it into date and grade or replace it with a class/session name.
The teacher-specified ordered unit caption, preserving punctuation and spacing.
The teacher-specified usage note. In this workflow it is the complete evaluation title. It is not a creator field or an extra native Print-item field.

usageHistory.verification: Source-qualified exact question histories and current target note; HTTP success alone does not establish a saved usage entry.

creator.verification: Read the saved target row under the authenticated Academy account; do not infer server-visible authorship from a local owner label.

futureChanges: Require explicit values for these distinct form fields. Retain immutable old revisions and regenerate through the original Academy program when printable fields change.
